d: 1 Industrial IoT plugin. Allows connection to one of the following protocols: BACnet, Modbus, OPC Client, HTTP Server, MQTT Client, SNMP, TCP Server. 1 additional GSC-IIoT part is required per additional protocol used at a time. Unlimited data point connections and IoT support (BACnet, Modbus, OPC Client, HTTP Server, MQTT Client, SNMP, TCP Server).
